AlertDefinition.name: BOM Attrition Rate Missing
AlertDefinition.Source: select bom.bomKey, s, bom.item, r.responsibilityKey from PcmAlertSubscription s, Bom bom, PcmResponsibility r where exists (select 1 from bom.bomLines where attritionRate is null) and bom.isRepairs = 1 and bom.status = 'APPROVED' and exists (select a.item from ItemAssignment a where a.item = bom.item and s.user.userId = a.userId and s.alertType = 'BOMAttritionRateMissing' and s.subscribeFlag = 1

Detail.Label: @{name} alert for @{item}
Detail.Body: The approved @{item} BOM with responsibility @{responsibility} is missing an attrition rate for one of its BOMLines

List.name: BOMAttritionRateMissingResponsibility
List.Expression: exists (select 1 from s.options o where o.optionId = 'Responsibility' and (lower(o.optionValue) = lower('All') or lower(o.optionValue) = lower(a.responsibility)))
